edbDesc: A phenomenon whereby a substance is released from or through a surface. The process is the opposite of sorption (i.e adsorption and absorption). This occurs in a system being in the state of sorption equilibrium between bulk phase (fluid, i.e. gas or liquid solution) and an adsorbing surface (solid or boundary separating two fluids). When the concentration (or pressure) of substance in the bulk phase is lowered, some of the sorbed substance changes to the bulk state.
title: Desorption
pickWhy: Simply adsorption run in reverse (heating a desiccant to drive water off); Adsorption is the canonical card, in another batch.
